candidate.user_submission: Pikin dey 18 months old. Pikin no get cough and e no get wahala to breathe. Pikin get diarrhoea. Pikin no get fever. Pikin no get ear problem. Pikin no dey convulse now. Pikin never convulse before. Pikin no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. Pikin fit drink or breastfeed. Pikin no dey vomit everything. For diarrhoea check, pikin dey drink as e suppose. Pikin no get blood for stool. Pikin no dey restless or irritable. When dem pinch pikin skin, e return normal. Pikin eye no sink.
